acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional window caulking in areas like Daly City or San Bruno can vary based on several factors, including the number of windows, their size, accessibility, and the condition of existing caulk. Material costs for high-quality, durable sealants also play a role. Typically, homeowners can expect quotes to be per window or based on linear footage. It's best to get a detailed estimate from a local contractor after an on-site assessment.
